verdict.rationale: Swell automations (functions, webhooks, models) live as config files in an app directory. The CLI pushes them to a development store, keys separate test from live environments, and an agent can run a validate-deploy-verify loop, so file-based versioning and review in a dev or test store are implied. Nothing documents version history, change review, or rollback of deployed automations. Missing for 10: native version history for functions and webhooks, a documented review or approval step before promoting to live, an explicit rollback command or feature, and independent corroboration.
